# The Grit Institute

> Shannon Huffman Polson — one of the first women to fly the Apache helicopter in the U.S. Army — is a keynote speaker, author, and founder of The Grit Institute, delivering keynotes on courageous leadership, resilience, and decision-making under pressure.

Shannon Huffman Polson is the author of *The Grit Factor* and *North of Hope*. She founded The Grit Institute to help leaders and organizations build purpose, resilience, and meaning. She speaks on leadership, resilience, grit, decision-making under pressure, women in leadership, military leadership, high-performance teams, and courageous leadership.

Contact: Shannon@TheGritInstitute.com · +1-509-996-8011

## Books
- [The Grit Factor](https://www.thegritinstitute.com/the-grit-factor): Shannon Huffman Polson's book on the science and story of grit, and a framework for courageous, resilient leadership.
- [Other Books & Writing](https://www.thegritinstitute.com/other-books-writing): Includes *North of Hope*, on resilience, leadership, grief, and the wild.
